_note: Round-2 replacement for gem-standing. The full-length figure paints only 19% of the 560x630 photo column (bbox 68% transparent) so the dark tile read hollow; the two portraits the operator approved paint 46-48%. This shot is framed waist-up like those, and the subject now matches an article about the scale stalling. Depiction is deliberately dignified: clothed, square to camera, calm - no headless-torso crop, no before/after implication. v2 of this shot: loose curls trap studio background BETWEEN the strands, and the mask marks that background fully opaque, so it survives edge defringing and reads as a pale halo on the dark ground. Smooth pulled-back hair is what made the other two portraits cut cleanly.
